name: AFP Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of AFP using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of AFP in human serum or plasma samples. This test can be used as an aid in the diagnosis and monitoring of primary liver cancer. For professional and laboratory use only. This test can NOT be used to guide the diagnosis of pair trisomy 21.
